title: Agent Harness root setting.json
description: Workspace-level session roots used by the web UI session list.

server.description: Local HTTP server defaults. Explicit server options and environment variables override these values.

run_state_retention_ms.description: How long a finished run stays attachable, so a browser reload can still catch its completion.

tool_stream_interval_ms.description: Coalescing window for in-progress tool-call snapshots. Long arguments stream as one snapshot per window instead of one per delta; 0 streams every delta.

run_content_memory_bytes.description: Maximum in-memory UTF-8 bytes retained for the active output item's content before concatenated content spills to one responses.partial file in the response-turn staging directory. 0 spills any non-empty content immediately.

run_content_write_batch_bytes.description: Target UTF-8 content bytes per asynchronous append to responses.partial. Buffered content remains bounded by run_content_memory_bytes (with encoded-buffer overhead).

run_content_flush_interval_ms.description: Maximum delay before flushing a partial content append batch. 0 schedules immediate asynchronous flushing.

run_content_max_index_segments.description: Maximum item-range/contribution segments per active response before the writer compacts redundant ranges or the cache uses a correctness-first fallback.

sse_max_buffered_bytes.description: Maximum queued SSE response bytes per subscriber before the connection closes and can be reattached to a current snapshot.

sse_heartbeat_interval_ms.description: Gap between keep-alive frames on a run stream that has nothing else to send, such as during a long tool call. Keeps the browser from treating a quiet connection as dead. Keep it well below the browser's stall timeout. 0 disables the frames.

read_header_timeout_ms.description: Time a client has to send complete request headers before the connection is closed. Bounds slow-header clients. 0 disables the limit. There is deliberately no whole-request or response timeout, which would cut long-lived SSE run streams.

idle_timeout_ms.description: Time an idle keep-alive connection stays open between requests before it is closed. 0 disables the limit.

log_level.description: Go backend only. Minimum level of the structured server log. debug adds one access-log line per request (method, route template, status, duration, bytes); off disables logging. The TypeScript backend ignores this key.

log_format.description: Go backend only. Log line encoding: key=value text or one JSON object per line. The TypeScript backend ignores this key.

log_file.description: Go backend only. Append the server log to this file instead of standard error; a relative path is resolved against the directory of this setting file, the file is created with mode 0600, and the Go backend refuses to start when it cannot be opened. There is no rotation. Empty or absent logs to standard error. The TypeScript backend ignores this key.

conditional_requests.description: Answer session list and snapshot requests with 304 when the state they were built from is unchanged.

snapshot_turns.description: Newest turns included in a session snapshot; older ones are paged. 0 returns the whole transcript.

max_page_turns.description: Largest number of turns one cursor page may return.

max_inline_part_bytes.description: Inline text kept per transcript part, in bytes. A larger part is cut for transport, reports its full size, and is re-fetched whole through the message endpoint; 0 sends parts uncut.

allowed_origins.description: Exact browser origins permitted to call the API; configure the frontend dev-server origin when using its proxy. The server also requires AGENT_API_TOKEN in the environment.

path.description: Session-root directory relative to the system setting.json parent; absolute paths are used as-is.
